text: Eastgate Crescent is a residential local road that runs between Pharmacy Avenue and St. Clair Avenue East. As such, it has become a popular short cut, especially during rush hours. I've heard from a majority of the residents that they have serious concerns for their safety, and that of their children, due to the speeds of those cutting through. I support the residents' request for traffic calming.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Waived the poling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorize the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Eastgate Crescent, between Pharmacy Avenue and St Clair Avenue East. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install four speed humps on Eastgate Crescent, between Pharmacy Avenue and St Clair Avenue East, generally as shown on the attached Drawing TC-141, dated April 2023 from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services. 3. Reduced the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Eastgate Crescent, between Pharmacy Avenue and St. Clair Avenue East.
